images.name: evergarden_patch_infographic
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished, shareable portrait fantasy Minecraft infographic as a high-resolution PNG, intended for Thai-speaking server players. Clean ivory card panels, deep teal/navy background, restrained gold frames, subtle sky-island/cherry-blossom decoration around the edges, generous space, large exceptionally readable Thai typography. Render every Thai vowel and tone mark correctly. Image inputs are ITEM/MODEL REFERENCES, not edit targets: 1 a labelled four-cell board of Solar Apocalypse wand, Chronos: Final Hour wand, Core of the Sun amber orb, and Core of Time purple hourglass orb; 2 Wand of Restoration; 3 Core of Restoration; 4 a labelled board containing Whale, Garden and Observatory restoration altar models. Each board collects separate actual assets. Extract the named objects from their panels and preserve their original designs. Present these authentic items as clean cutouts or inventory sprite images, maintaining their distinctive supplied designs and pixel-art appearance; remove the reference previews' backgrounds and tiny technical captions. Do not invent or redesign the wands, cores, or altars. Make the item pictures the main attraction, especially the two supplied flat pixel-art wands and their newly designed separate round cores. No photo, no fake game screenshot, no server-code or installation notes, no damage values or cooldown values, no extra rewards or guessed drop rates. Keep all source and ability statements correct and use only the exact copy specified below. Avoid excessive extra text. Do not reproduce technical text from reference images.
Asset: EVERGARDEN NEW PATCH UPDATE announcement poster. Make pictures dominate, with a short repair section above and two equal large Mythic wand cards below.
Exact headline: "EVERGARDEN"
Subheadline: "NEW PATCH UPDATE"
Tagline: "ระบบซ่อมคทา • 2 คทา MYTHIC ใหม่"
Repair section title: "ฟื้นฟูคทา แล้วออกผจญภัยต่อ"
Show the 3 actual altar models side by side with short labels "Whale", "Garden", "Observatory".
Shared location caption: "ค้นหาในพื้นที่ใหม่ที่ยังไม่เคยสำรวจ"
Show restoration core and restoration wand in two spacious cards:
"Core of Restoration"
"จากกล่องหลักของทั้ง 3 สถานที่"
"ใช้ 1 Core ที่แท่น เพื่อฟื้นคทาจนเต็ม"
"Wand of Restoration"
"สุ่มพบในกล่องหลักของทั้ง 3 สถานที่"
"ซ่อมคทาให้เพื่อน • ใช้ได้ 5 ครั้ง"
Small but clearly readable inset, optional broken-stone miniature illustration:
"บางแห่งเป็นซากแท่นที่ใช้ซ่อมไม่ได้"
"แตะหินกลางลาน เพื่อดูพิกัดแท่นใกล้เคียง"
Section "2 คทาใหม่ ระดับ MYTHIC"
Solar card with original supplied wand sprite and amber Sun core orb:
"Solar Apocalypse"
"Core of the Sun"
"สุริยัน 5 ชั้นถล่มพร้อมกัน"
"สร้างทะเลลาวาชั่วคราว"
Chronos card with original wand sprite and purple hourglass Time core:
"Chronos: Final Hour"
"Core of Time"
"ตรึงศัตรูและยิงลำแสงนาฬิกา"
"สร้างน้ำพิษชั่วคราว"
One shared footer location/crafting block:
"หา Core ทั้งสองจาก Evergarden Vault ในวิหาร"
"คราฟต์: Core ตรงกลาง + Netherite Ingot หรือ Nether Star รอบนอก 8 ชิ้น"
Final small footer: "/evergarden guide • Java & Bedrock"
No numeric drop percentages on this announcement. Use no more text than supplied. Every item must be big enough to recognize; the wand sprites must remain thin diagonal shafts like references, not ornate redesigned 3D staffs.
